# Strain API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

The shared list of strains, each belonging to a species.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/strain/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/taxonomies/strain/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `strain` (detail, create, update), `strains` (list)
- **Permissions:** see the [permissions page](/datamodel/permissions/)
- **Deleting:** refused (400) while [`subject`](/api/stem/subject/) records point to it

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 100 characters |
| `popular_name` | string; max 100 characters |
| `description` | string; max 2000 characters |
| `species` | [`species`](/api/taxonomies/species/) id **[required]**; nestable |
| `breeding` | one of `I`, `O`, `W`, `U` **[required]** |
| `rrid` | string; max 100 characters; nullable. Research Resource Identifier (RRID) for tracking standardized research resources |
| `rrid_url` | string **[read-only]** |
| `external_identifiers` | JSON object; nullable. External identifiers and their source URLs from various databases (NCBI, JAX, DOI, etc.) |
| `comments` | string |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/strain/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('strain', load_all=True)
records = resp['strains']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('strain', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.strains;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "strains": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "name": "Strain 1",
            "popular_name": "",
            "description": "",
            "species": "<species-id>",
            "breeding": "I",
            "rrid": "",
            "rrid_url": "",
            "external_identifiers": {},
            "comments": ""
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/strain/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('strain', data={"name": "Strain 1", "species": "<species-id>", "breeding": "I"})
record = resp.json()['strain']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Strain 1', 'species', '<species-id>', 'breeding', 'I'), 'strain');
record = created.strain;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/strain/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('strain', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['strain']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('strain', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.strain;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "strain": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "name": "Strain 1",
        "popular_name": "",
        "description": "",
        "species": "<species-id>",
        "breeding": "I",
        "rrid": "",
        "rrid_url": "",
        "external_identifiers": {},
        "comments": ""
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/strain/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('strain', id='<id>', data={"name": "Strain 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Strain 1 (renamed)'), 'strain', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/strain/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('strain', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'strain');
```

## JSON field schemas

Schema for the external identifiers of a strain. The REST API returns these JSON fields as stored and validates writes against the schemas below. Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Strain/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; see [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).

### External Identifiers

- type code `ExternalIdentifiers` · version 1.1.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Strain/ExternalIdentifiers/1.1.0.json)

Add external identifiers from databases like NCBI, JAX, DOI, etc. Include URLs when available.

| Property | Description |
|:---------|:------------|
| `source` | choice **[required]**; one of `NCBI`, `JAX`, `MGI`, `RGD`, `BDSC`, `FlyBase`, `ZFIN`, `RBRC`, `IMSR`, `Criver`, `Taconic`, `Envigo`, `Harlan`, `DOI`, `Custom`, `Other`; default `"NCBI"` |
| `id` | Identifier: text **[required]** |
| `url` | URL (optional): text |

Illustrative payload:

```json
[
    {
        "source": "NCBI",
        "id": "text",
        "url": "text"
    }
]
```


## Data model

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Strain data model page](/datamodel/taxonomies/strain/).
